title: bolt.local.yaml
description: Per-machine overrides (gitignored). vars override bolt.yaml vars. plugins maps a namespace to an opaque object that is deep-merged over that plugin's config before the plugin validates it. capabilities overrides bolt.yaml capabilities per key; an empty object is the same as omitting the key.

capabilities.description: Per-key override of bolt.yaml capabilities. An empty object is the same as omitting the key.

ai.description: Per-machine agent policy. ai.run never refuses every agent execute. Omitted ai.run means confirm and does not block ai:true plans. ai.trust_plugins lifts the non-builtin confirm cap. It never lifts ai:false or a plugin that shadows a built-in namespace.

run.description: never refuses agent execute (AGENT_EXECUTION_DISABLED). confirm is the default and does not block ai:true plans.

trust_plugins.description: Namespaces whose handlers may keep ai:true. Does not lift ai:false or shadowing.

plugins.description: Per-namespace overrides. Each value is opaque and deep-merged before that plugin validates it.
